1,lpddr4_mem_half_data_bus_width_test,"This testcase verifies LPDDR4 memory data integrity when operating in half data bus width mode (bus_width = 1). The test configures the LPDDR4 controller and PHY base addresses based on the DRAM type (APS_DRAM or MPS_DRAM), sets bus_width to 1 (Half Bus), selects the speed grade (SG3200 default, SG2667, or SG2133 via preprocessor defines), disables Data Bus Inversion (<NRP> = 0) and <PERSON> (DM_EN = 0), performs LPDDR4 memory training via <PERSON>(), confirms training completion via training_done(), waits 1000 units for stabilization via wait_on(1000), then performs 64-bit read-back verification on <PERSON> (conditionally compiled based on XOR of initiator/DRAM combinations) and <PERSON> (unconditionally) at offsets 0x100 and 0x108. Read data is compared against expected patterns 0x3333333333333333 and 0x2222222222222222. Errors are accumulated in err0 and the test concludes with finish(err0).","1. File-scope declarations:
